scenario: A module is referenced by a floating tag whose content changed since the trust review; unpinned resolution cannot be verified and is quarantined.
when: the module reference is resolved at load time

reasons: reference 'latest' resolved to 2.1.0, which is not the reviewed, pinned 2.0.0
remediation names pinning to an exact version and re-running trust review
must_not: execute the newly resolved content under the old trust decision
treat a semver-compatible bump as exempt from re-verification
